PolyCup 0.4

Custom and ranked Cups for PolyTrack 0.6.3, by Kiki.

Open PolyCup from the main menu. Host a public or private Cup for 2–8 racers, browse public Cups, or join using a room code. Customize presets, draft tracks, race through automatic rounds and follow live rankings.

Sign in with Discord for friends, invitations and ranked matchmaking. Accept a found match, ban and pick tracks, then race for a persistent rating. Ranked uses two bans and two picks per racer, three rounds per track and a 140-point finalist target.

See your rating change after the Cup, compare global and friends leaderboards, and browse public match histories. Five provisional matches establish your initial rank. Grandmaster belongs to the top ten qualifying Master players.

Racers have two minutes to reconnect while the host's race remains available; abandoning counts as a loss. A participating player hosts the race, and a closed host race cannot be restored. Input comparison flags possible copied inputs in match history without automatic penalties.

All participants need the same version. Install 0.4.0 explicitly if the latest-version cache has not refreshed, then restart the game.
